target.title: fix(cron): skip heartbeat-enabled checks for cron-sourced main-session wakes (#101537)
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Cron jobs with `sessionTarget: "main"` that deliver systemEvent payloads are skipped with `status: "skipped", error: "disabled"` when the main agent doesn't have heartbeat scheduling configured. The cron job fires on schedule but the main session is never woken.

Root cause: `runHeartbeatOnce` checks `isHeartbeatEnabledForAgent(cfg, agentId)` and `resolveHeartbeatIntervalMs()` before executing. When another agent has heartbeat configured but "main" does not, `isHeartbeatEnabledForAgent(cfg, "main")` returns false — causing the skip.

## Why This Change Was Made

Cron jobs manage their own scheduling via `CronService`. The per-agent heartbeat config and interval resolution checks are designed for the heartbeat scheduler, not for cron-sourced wakes. The fix wraps these two checks in `if (opts.source !== "cron")` so cron-sourced runs bypass them while still respecting the global `areHeartbeatsEnabled()` toggle.

## User Impact

- Cron jobs with `sessionTarget: "main"` now work correctly even when the main agent doesn't have heartbeat scheduling configured
- The global heartbeat toggle still applies — cron jobs are skipped when heartbeats are globally disabled
- No change for regular heartbeat scheduling behavior

## Evidence

- 45/45 tests pass in heartbeat-runner.returns-default-unset.test.ts (including 2 new regression tests)
- Format clean (oxfmt)

Fixes #101537
